findings.detail: All bases whose logs are split are positive. With L=log x>0 and log A+log B=(theta-2delta)L, the first bound uses theta<=5/8 and delta<=1/12; the second uses the second min upper endpoint; the third uses the first min upper endpoint. No lower bound on alpha or delta is needed for the three stronger private-core inequalities.

The second and third products parse as (((u*A)*a)*b^5). The three log_mul rewrites first expose log b^5, then log a, then log A; the remaining log_rpow and, in the third case, log_div apply to exactly u. The first product is A^2*b. No logarithm of a zero/negative base is used.

actualSelectedSubproductUpper alpha theta is definitionally the displayed min. The transitivity goals expose its left and right affine upper endpoints, and multiplication preserves the inequalities because log x>0.

Writing lA=log A,lB=log B,la=log a,lb=log b, the respective logarithms are 2lA+lb; (7alpha/32)L+lA+la+5lb; (7/16)(lA-lb)+lA+la+5lb. Using la<=lA and lb<=lB, the last simplifies to at most (39/16)(lA+lB)+(17/8)lB, yielding (2-39delta/8)L. These are polynomial consequences suitable for nlinarith; tactic success is not asserted.

The public theorem derives A>=1 from x^delta<=A and delta>0. Its original A upper range, theta>=1/2 and tiny positive delta give A<=D, hence D/A>=1. It calls the existing deterministic full-vector repair on the complete original input, yielding actualTwoCapacityFactors A input and D/A<b0. Original input positivity makes the literal original product positive and therefore both natural factors positive.

The formerly selected b0 is used solely through positivity, D/(A*b0)<1 and its true upper bound. It is allowed to change to the full-vector greedy right factor. Its divisor relation to input and a lower critical bound are unnecessary for this numerical repair, and no coprimality claim is made.
Positive delta implies 2-4delta<=2-3delta and 2-39delta/8<=2-2delta; monotonicity of real powers at x>1 yields exactly the three c=1 manuscript targets.

The appended public consumer derives positive first-three entries from the full original positivity premise, obtains source inflation and selected-pair upper bound from actualExtendedThirdSelectedPair_arithmeticInputs, obtains the same frozen theta range from wholeCell, and invokes the full-vector repair with alpha=1+3kappa and the actual pair product. Caller supplies neither replacement remainder support, a pair square gate, nor a monomial/action license.
